notes: Schmidt Spiele article 40829 base rules and official rulebook directly checked; exclude Royal variants.

Cockroach Poker has no printed board. This original six-seat diagram covers the whole tabletop state: each owner-private hand, public face-up card collections for all eight species, active face-down offer, changing public claim, accept/pass choice, visited-player chain, reveal/resolution, and match status.
The 2-player removed cards are shown as one hidden group rather than ten fabricated identity slots; standard rules do not have a draw deck after setup.
Eight collection cells per player are a UI projection for readable grouped state; the rules say face-up in front of a player, not fixed category piles.
No fixed hand count, per-species copy count, legal move validation, or hidden identity is inferred.
손패 영역의 카드 뒷면 실루엣은 영역 표식이며 시작 카드 수나 실제 손패 수를 뜻하지 않는다.

structureEvidence.location: official publisher product page, article 40829; player count and game mechanism
structureEvidence.verifiedFacts: 2–6 players; one player offers a face-down creature card and states a creature, truthfully or falsely; four same-creature cards cause a loss.

structureEvidence.location: official rulebook English section pp.9–13; component diagram pp.2 and 8
structureEvidence.verifiedFacts: 64 cards; eight creature identities rat, scorpion, cockroach, stink bug, bat, spider, fly, toad. All cards are shuffled and dealt face down in standard setup. Players may accept and call true/false, or secretly inspect and pass only to a player who has not seen the card; if no unseen player remains, accept is required. The one who must keep the card starts the next round. Loss by four of a kind or being required to start without a hand card. Two-player setup removes ten cards face down and omits passing; five of a kind causes loss.

assetScope: Self-contained full-table tabletop layout and resumable state description for the Schmidt Spiele base game; no app integration or automatic rules engine is claimed.

tableModel.purpose: Declarative visual/session contract for recording and resuming the physical table. It does not enforce legal moves or resolve rules automatically.

excluded: Cockroach Poker Royal and other variants

players.seatOrder: stable session seat IDs; the schematic seat locations are not official fixed positions

physicalInventory.perCreatureCopyCount: not asserted by this asset; preserve actual identity from observed cards

setupVariants.deal: Shuffle all 64 cards and deal face down among active players; exact hand sizes may differ.
Shuffle, remove ten cards face down without looking, then deal all remaining cards face down to both players.
notes: Two-player rules omit the pass option.

hand.publicCount: unspecified; do not infer or expose a count as a rule fact

collectedCards.displayProjection: optional grouping by creature kind into eight areas; physical rules require face-up cards in front of player, not fixed piles

offerState.instanceId: stable card instance ID or null

actualCreatureId.visibility: sender and only the player IDs recorded as having privately inspected the card

offerState.currentClaimCreatureId: one of the eight creature IDs or null; public claim, may change at each pass
offerState.visitedPlayerIds: ordered player IDs who have seen/received the current offered card
offerState.passHistory: ordered array of {fromPlayerId,toPlayerId,claimCreatureId,privatelyInspected,confirmedPriorClaim}; retain each pass and claim change

roundState.history: ordered list of resolved offerState summaries; preserve state through resume

gameState.removedCards: array of ten unknown card identities for two-player; empty for standard; null if setup unknown
gameState.winnerPlayerIds: all other players on a loss or null while unresolved

visibilityRules: Offered card stays face down to the public; sender knows its identity and a recipient gains knowledge only after secret inspection.
A public claim is not the actual card identity.
Unknown card identity remains null; do not infer from claimed kind, inventory, or prior probability.
resumeRequirements: sender and current recipient of an unresolved offer
actual identity visibility set separated from public claim
full ordered pass/claim history and visited-player set
resolved revealed card, keeper, and next-round starter
each player hand identity private to owner and public collected card identities
setup variant and 2-player removed-card unknown identities/count
loss threshold, loser, other winners, and game status
physicalConstraints: There are 64 creature cards and eight pictured creature identities.
Standard setup distributes all cards face down; exact hand sizes need not match.
Two-player setup removes ten cards face down before dealing and removes the pass option.
The card is passed only to a player who has not yet seen that offer; the last player must accept.
If receiver guesses true/false correctly, sender keeps the revealed card; if incorrect, receiver keeps it. The keeper begins the next round.
A player loses on four identical creature cards, or when required to start without a card; in two-player mode, the set threshold is five.
uncertainties: The asset does not claim exact printed copies per creature type.
Grouping collected cards by creature is a readable display projection, not an official fixed mat or mandatory physical pile.
No legal-move or bluff-resolution engine is included.

assetCompleteness: Complete 2–6 player card-table layout: private hands, all eight face-up collection categories per seat, active hidden offer, claim/decision state, pass chain, two-player removed-card reserve, and match/round status.
